description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException' for the OpenMRS API, specifically to handle cases when patient identifier types are locked and cannot be manipulated.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class thrown when operations on patient identifier types are attempted while they are locked.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating the patient identifier type is locked.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom message and a cause for exception chaining.

methods.name: PatientIdentifierTypeLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a cause, used for chaining exceptions without a custom message.
